skills.name: Water Slash
lore: Slash forward with a water slash
STRIKE 3: Slash upward at the enemy in front of you.
STRIKE 4: Slash forward with your greatsword,
STRIKE 5: Leap forward slightly and slash your greatsword

skills.name: Loong Charge
lore: Summon a water loong and charge with it.
After charging, you will briefly have a slow fall effect.

skills.name: Loong Whirl
lore: Summons a massive water loong in front of you,
attacking wide area with water blast.

skills.name: GreatSword Wave
lore: Summons a greatsword made of water that attacks
in front of you and unfolds a circular wave area (repeat 3 times)
enemies receive slow debuffs for {duration} sec.

skills.name: Parry
lore: Raise a watery greatsword in front of you to block attacks for 3 sec.
3 seconds later, you will swing your greatsword forward
causing waterwaves to ripple from side to side.
and give slow, weakness effect to enemy for {duration} sec

skills.name: Surge
lore: Slash forward with a water slash using loong power
STRIKE 1-2: Performs a horizontal slash. with loong
STRIKE 3: Slash upward at the enemy in front of you,
STRIKE 4: Slash forward with your greatsword,
STRIKE 5: Charges forward with a water dragon
causing waterwaves to ripple from side to side where he passes.
and give slow, weakness effect to enemy for {duration} sec
